practice_exams.answer: We practice speaking after the lesson.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Write one sentence about what a teacher does.
practice_exams.prompt: Write one sentence about what a teacher does.

小学一年级 / Primary Year 1.title: Time and sequence / 时间与顺序

practice_exams.rubric: Record audio and assess content, pronunciation and fluency; do not auto-pass without valid assessment.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Write two sentences about yesterday and tomorrow.
practice_exams.prompt: Write two sentences about yesterday and tomorrow.
practice_exams.answer_example: I studied yesterday. I will read tomorrow.
practice_exams.rubric: Assess task response, grammar and spelling; allow other correct answers.

小学一年级 / Primary Year 1.title: Weather and changes / 天气与变化
小学一年级 / Primary Year 1.grammar: Cause and effect; past tense / 原因结果与过去时

vocabulary.example_en: She takes an umbrella when it rains.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and type the sentence.
practice_exams.audio_script: She carried an umbrella yesterday.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Choose the best answer.
practice_exams.prompt: The sky is cloudy, so I will ___ an umbrella.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Read the sentence aloud.
practice_exams.prompt: The weather changed during the afternoon.
practice_exams.answer: The weather changed during the afternoon.
practice_exams.rubric: Record audio and assess content, pronunciation and fluency; do not auto-pass without valid assessment.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Write one sentence explaining why you take an umbrella.
practice_exams.prompt: Write one sentence explaining why you take an umbrella.
practice_exams.answer_example: I take an umbrella because it might rain.
practice_exams.rubric: Assess task response, grammar and spelling; allow other correct answers.

小学一年级 / Primary Year 1.title: Health and habits / 健康与习惯
小学一年级 / Primary Year 1.grammar: Modals should/can; advice / 情态动词与建议

vocabulary.example_en: A healthy breakfast helps me learn.
You should rest when you feel tired.
She feels tired after the game.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and type the missing word.
practice_exams.prompt: You should ___ when you feel tired.
practice_exams.audio_script: You should rest when you feel tired.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Read and choose the correct answer.
practice_exams.prompt: Leo exercises often and sleeps well. He feels strong. Which habit is mentioned?

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen once and repeat.
practice_exams.audio_script: We should rest after exercise.
practice_exams.rubric: Record audio and assess content, pronunciation and fluency; do not auto-pass without valid assessment.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Write two sentences giving advice for healthy habits.
practice_exams.prompt: Write two sentences giving advice for healthy habits.
practice_exams.answer_example: You should exercise often. You should sleep enough.
practice_exams.rubric: Assess task response, grammar and spelling; allow other correct answers.

小学一年级 / Primary Year 1.title: Information and reading / 信息与阅读
小学一年级 / Primary Year 1.grammar: Main idea; reference words / 主旨与指代

vocabulary.example_en: The story is about a family.
Find one detail in the text.
The main idea is easy to find.
Give an example from the story.
The meaning is clear from the sentence.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and type the sentence.
practice_exams.audio_script: The main idea is in the first paragraph.
practice_exams.answer: The main idea is in the first paragraph.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Read and choose the main idea.
practice_exams.prompt: Nina reads every evening. She enjoys stories about animals and shares them with her brother. What is the main idea?

practice_exams.instruction_en: Read the sentence aloud.
practice_exams.prompt: An example can help explain the meaning.
practice_exams.answer: An example can help explain the meaning.
practice_exams.rubric: Record audio and assess content, pronunciation and fluency; do not auto-pass without valid assessment.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Write one sentence about the main idea of this text: “Birds build nests. They keep their eggs in nests.”
practice_exams.prompt: Write one sentence about the main idea of this text: “Birds build nests. They keep their eggs in nests.”
practice_exams.answer_example: Birds use nests to protect their eggs.
practice_exams.rubric: Assess task response, grammar and spelling; allow other correct answers.

小学一年级 / Primary Year 1.title: Numbers and comparisons / 数量与比较
小学一年级 / Primary Year 1.grammar: Comparatives; quantities / 比较级与数量表达

vocabulary.example_en: How much water do you need?
This story is longer than that one.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and type the missing word.
practice_exams.prompt: We have ___ time to finish.
practice_exams.audio_script: We have enough time to finish.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Choose the best answer.
practice_exams.prompt: There are ___ chairs than students.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen once and repeat.
practice_exams.audio_script: The second story is shorter than the first.
practice_exams.answer: The second story is shorter than the first.
practice_exams.rubric: Record audio and assess content, pronunciation and fluency; do not auto-pass without valid assessment.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Write one sentence comparing two stories.
practice_exams.prompt: Write one sentence comparing two stories.
practice_exams.answer_example: The first story is longer than the second.
practice_exams.rubric: Assess task response, grammar and spelling; allow other correct answers.

幼儿园大班 / Kindergarten Senior.title: Food and quantities / 食物与数量
幼儿园大班 / Kindergarten Senior.grammar: Singular/plural nouns; a/an; there is / 名词单复数、冠词与存在句

vocabulary.example_en: There is an apple on the table.
We eat bread in the morning.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and type the complete sentence.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 复数名词cups；语音原文在提交前隐藏。
practice_exams.audio_script: There are three cups.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Choose the best word for the blank.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: There are与复数名词搭配。
practice_exams.prompt: There ___ four apples on the table.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Read the sentence aloud.
practice_exams.answer: I have some bread and milk.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 检查完整朗读、基本清晰度和停顿；必须实际录音。
practice_exams.prompt: I have some bread and milk.
practice_exams.rubric: Record speech; assess word coverage, pronunciation and fluency. No automatic pass without reliable evaluation.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Write one complete sentence using 'banana' and 'have'.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 检查主谓结构、拼写、冠词与句意；允许其他正确表达。
practice_exams.prompt: Write one complete sentence using 'banana' and 'have'.
practice_exams.rubric: Assess meaning, grammar and spelling; accept equivalent correct answers.

幼儿园大班 / Kindergarten Senior.title: Places and movement / 地点与移动
幼儿园大班 / Kindergarten Senior.grammar: Prepositions and simple directions / 地点介词与简单指路

vocabulary.example_en: The shop is near the school.
The park is near my home.
The ball is under the chair.
The shop is behind the school.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and type the missing word.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 听力语音不显示；识别near。
practice_exams.audio_script: The park is near my home.
practice_exams.prompt: The park is ___ my home.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Choose the best word for the blank.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 通过上下文判断空间位置。
practice_exams.prompt: The ball is ___ the chair. It is not on the chair.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and repeat the sentence.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 检查实际复述是否完整、清晰；必须录音。
practice_exams.audio_script: We walk to the park.
practice_exams.rubric: Record speech; assess word coverage, pronunciation and fluency. No automatic pass without reliable evaluation.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Write one sentence using 'shop' and 'near'.
practice_exams.answer: The shop is near my school.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 检查句子结构与介词使用；允许其他正确表达。
practice_exams.prompt: Write one sentence using 'shop' and 'near'.
practice_exams.rubric: Assess meaning, grammar and spelling; accept equivalent correct answers.

幼儿园大班 / Kindergarten Senior.title: Actions and time / 动作与时间
幼儿园大班 / Kindergarten Senior.grammar: Present simple vs present continuous / 一般现在时与现在进行时

vocabulary.example_en: The children run in the park.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and type the complete sentence.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 注意现在进行时be + -ing。
practice_exams.audio_script: She is reading now.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Choose the best word for the blank.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: every morning表示规律性活动。
practice_exams.prompt: He walks to school ___ morning.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Read the sentence aloud.
practice_exams.answer: They are standing near the door.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 检查连读、清晰度、完整性；必须录音。
practice_exams.prompt: They are standing near the door.
practice_exams.rubric: Record speech; assess word coverage, pronunciation and fluency. No automatic pass without reliable evaluation.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Write one sentence about what you are doing now.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 检查现在进行时和句意；允许其他正确表达。
practice_exams.prompt: Write one sentence about what you are doing now.
practice_exams.rubric: Assess meaning, grammar and spelling; accept equivalent correct answers.

幼儿园大班 / Kindergarten Senior.title: Descriptions and reasons / 描述与原因
幼儿园大班 / Kindergarten Senior.grammar: Adjectives; because; simple comparisons / 形容词、because与简单比较

vocabulary.example_en: I stay home because it is cold.
A bus is faster than walking.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and type the missing word.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 听出表示原因的连接词。
practice_exams.audio_script: I stay home because it is cold.
practice_exams.prompt: I stay home ___ it is cold.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Choose the best word for the blank.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 比较级faster than。
practice_exams.prompt: The bus is faster ___ walking.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and repeat the sentence.
practice_exams.answer: We need more water because it is hot.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 检查完整复述、流利度；必须录音。
practice_exams.audio_script: We need more water because it is hot.
practice_exams.rubric: Record speech; assess word coverage, pronunciation and fluency. No automatic pass without reliable evaluation.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Write one sentence using 'because' and 'cold'.
practice_exams.answer: I wear a coat because it is cold.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 检查because连接原因与结果；允许其他正确表达。
practice_exams.prompt: Write one sentence using 'because' and 'cold'.
practice_exams.rubric: Assess meaning, grammar and spelling; accept equivalent correct answers.

小学三年级 / Primary Year 3.title: Learning and research / 学习与研究
小学三年级 / Primary Year 3.grammar: Present perfect introduction; question formation / 现在完成时入门与提问

vocabulary.example_en: We research the history of our town.
Our science project is about clean energy.
We used a simple method to test the idea.
The students completed a short questionnaire.
The teacher asked us to check each source.
The report describes one important finding.
Write a short summary of the article.
We hope to discover something new.

practice_exams.prompt: The class completed a short ___ about local transport.
practice_exams.audio_script: The class completed a short survey about local transport.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 听辨关键词或完整句子，作答前隐藏音频原文。

practice_exams.instruction_en: Read and complete the task.
practice_exams.prompt: The teacher asked us to check every ___ before writing our report.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 依据语境、事实或逻辑顺序作答。

practice_exams.instruction_en: Read the text aloud.
practice_exams.prompt: The survey results suggest that students prefer shorter journeys.
practice_exams.answer: The survey results suggest that students prefer shorter journeys.
practice_exams.rubric: Record spoken answer and assess content, pronunciation, fluency and task relevance; no automatic pass.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Write three sentences describing a class survey, what it asked and one possible result.
practice_exams.prompt: Write three sentences describing a class survey, what it asked and one possible result.
practice_exams.answer_example: Our class surveyed students about transport. We asked how they travel to school. Most students said they walk.
practice_exams.rubric: Evaluate task response, coherence, grammar, vocabulary and spelling; accept alternative valid answers.

小学三年级 / Primary Year 3.title: People and communication / 人际沟通
小学三年级 / Primary Year 3.grammar: Reported speech introduction; polite requests / 间接引语与礼貌请求

vocabulary.example_en: We had a conversation after class.
We discuss our ideas in groups.

The student made a polite request.
She will respond to the message later.
I agree with your main point.
I received a message this morning.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and complete the task.
practice_exams.audio_script: The speaker answered the question clearly.
practice_exams.answer: The speaker answered the question clearly.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 听辨关键词或完整句子，作答前隐藏音频原文。

practice_exams.instruction_en: Read and complete the task.
practice_exams.prompt: Arrange the report process.

answer: First, we asked thirty students questions.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 依据语境、事实或逻辑顺序作答。

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and repeat.
practice_exams.audio_script: Could you please clarify the main point of your message?
practice_exams.answer: Could you please clarify the main point of your message?
practice_exams.rubric: Record spoken answer and assess content, pronunciation, fluency and task relevance; no automatic pass.

practice_exams.answer_example: I understand your opinion. However, I disagree because the bus is often slower. I prefer walking for short trips.
practice_exams.rubric: Evaluate task response, coherence, grammar, vocabulary and spelling; accept alternative valid answers.

小学三年级 / Primary Year 3.title: Health and lifestyle / 健康与生活
小学三年级 / Primary Year 3.grammar: Advice, obligation and conditionals / 建议、义务与条件句

Relaxation is important after a busy day.
Breakfast gives us energy for the morning.
Too much stress can affect sleep.
Washing hands can prevent some illnesses.
Good hydration is important in hot weather.
Walking is a simple physical activity.
The nurse gave us useful advice.

practice_exams.prompt: Regular ___ can improve your energy.
practice_exams.audio_script: Regular exercise can improve your energy.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 听辨关键词或完整句子，作答前隐藏音频原文。

practice_exams.prompt: Mia sleeps eight hours and walks to school daily. Her friend stays up late and feels tired in class. Which habit is linked to Mia feeling more rested?
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 依据语境、事实或逻辑顺序作答。

practice_exams.instruction_en: Read the text aloud.
practice_exams.prompt: A balanced routine includes exercise, healthy food and enough rest.
practice_exams.answer: A balanced routine includes exercise, healthy food and enough rest.
practice_exams.rubric: Record spoken answer and assess content, pronunciation, fluency and task relevance; no automatic pass.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Write three sentences giving advice to a tired student.

practice_exams.answer_example: You should sleep earlier. You could also take a short walk. These habits may help you feel better.
practice_exams.rubric: Evaluate task response, coherence, grammar, vocabulary and spelling; accept alternative valid answers.

小学三年级 / Primary Year 3.title: Travel and public information / 出行与公共信息

The train leaves from platform two.
Each passenger needs a valid ticket.
The flight had a short delay.
They may cancel the trip because of rain.
We need to reserve our seats.
Our destination is a small coastal town.
This route is shorter than the other one.
An announcement was made at the station.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and complete the task.
practice_exams.audio_script: The train was delayed by twenty minutes.
practice_exams.answer: The train was delayed by twenty minutes.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 听辨关键词或完整句子，作答前隐藏音频原文。

practice_exams.instruction_en: Read and complete the task.
practice_exams.prompt: The flight was ___ because of heavy fog, so passengers left the airport.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 依据语境、事实或逻辑顺序作答。

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and repeat.
practice_exams.audio_script: The announcement said that our train would arrive late.
practice_exams.answer: The announcement said that our train would arrive late.
practice_exams.rubric: Record spoken answer and assess content, pronunciation, fluency and task relevance; no automatic pass.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Write three sentences about a delayed journey and what you would do.

practice_exams.answer_example: My train was delayed today. I checked the announcement at the station. Then I informed my teacher.
practice_exams.rubric: Evaluate task response, coherence, grammar, vocabulary and spelling; accept alternative valid answers.

小学三年级 / Primary Year 3.title: Technology and media / 科技与媒体
小学三年级 / Primary Year 3.grammar: Relative clauses; comparison of claims / 定语从句与信息比较

vocabulary.example_en: We use digital maps when travelling.
The school website has a new page.
Choose a strong password for your account.
Online privacy is important to families.
You can download the file at home.
The meeting will take place online.
The screen shows the next question.
I read an article about ocean life.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and complete the task.
practice_exams.prompt: Check whether the information is ___.
practice_exams.audio_script: Check whether the information is reliable.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 听辨关键词或完整句子，作答前隐藏音频原文。

practice_exams.instruction_en: Read and complete the task.
practice_exams.prompt: A website asks for your password through an unexpected email. The school says it never requests passwords by email. What should you do?
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 依据语境、事实或逻辑顺序作答。

practice_exams.instruction_en: Respond to the situation aloud.
practice_exams.prompt: A classmate asks you to share your password. Politely refuse and explain why.
practice_exams.answer_example: I am sorry, but I cannot share my password because it is private.
practice_exams.rubric: Record spoken answer and assess content, pronunciation, fluency and task relevance; no automatic pass.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Write three sentences about checking information on a website.

practice_exams.answer_example: I read an article online. I checked its author and source. I did not share it until I knew it was reliable.
practice_exams.rubric: Evaluate task response, coherence, grammar, vocabulary and spelling; accept alternative valid answers.

小学三年级 / Primary Year 3.title: Environment and solutions / 环境与解决方案
小学三年级 / Primary Year 3.grammar: Cause-effect chains; argument structure / 因果链与论证结构

vocabulary.example_en: Climate affects the plants in a region.
The temperature fell during the night.
Water is an important natural resource.
The school uses less electricity now.
Solar power is a renewable energy source.
We can reuse some glass containers.
The group proposed a practical solution.
Air pollution is a major challenge.
The new plan has several benefits.
Transport has an impact on the environment.
The conclusion follows from the evidence.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and complete the task.
practice_exams.audio_script: The new plan may reduce electricity use.
practice_exams.answer: The new plan may reduce electricity use.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 听辨关键词或完整句子，作答前隐藏音频原文。

practice_exams.instruction_en: Read and complete the task.
practice_exams.prompt: Arrange the explanation.

The town introduced more recycling bins.
More people began separating paper and plastic.
answer: The town introduced more recycling bins.
More people began separating paper and plastic.
As a result, less waste enters the river.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 依据语境、事实或逻辑顺序作答。

practice_exams.instruction_en: Read the text aloud.
practice_exams.prompt: Renewable energy can reduce the environmental impact of electricity production.
practice_exams.answer: Renewable energy can reduce the environmental impact of electricity production.
practice_exams.rubric: Record spoken answer and assess content, pronunciation, fluency and task relevance; no automatic pass.

小学二年级 / Primary Year 2.title: Community and jobs / 社区与职业

The hospital is across the street.
The station is beside the bank.
The driver stops at the station.
The library is on King Street.
The shop is on the corner.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and complete the task.
practice_exams.prompt: The nurse works at the ___.
practice_exams.audio_script: The nurse works at the hospital.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 听力原文仅供系统播放，作答前不得展示。

practice_exams.prompt: A visitor needs a book. The library is beside the station. Where should the visitor go?
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 依据文本逻辑或细节作答；段落排序要求完整顺序。

practice_exams.instruction_en: Read aloud.

practice_exams.answer: The driver stops near the station.
practice_exams.rubric: Record actual speech; assess content, intelligibility and fluency. No automatic pass without validated assessment.

小学二年级 / Primary Year 2.title: Daily routines / 日常作息

I wake up early on each weekday.
The driver is punctual every day.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and complete the task.
practice_exams.audio_script: She sometimes eats lunch at home.
practice_exams.answer: She sometimes eats lunch at home.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 听力原文仅供系统播放，作答前不得展示。

practice_exams.instruction_en: Read and complete the task.
practice_exams.prompt: Put these sentences in the correct order.
practice_exams.explanation_zh: 依据文本逻辑或细节作答；段落排序要求完整顺序。

practice_exams.instruction_en: Listen and repeat.
practice_exams.audio_script: We usually prepare dinner together.
practice_exams.rubric: Record actual speech; assess content, intelligibility and fluency. No automatic pass without validated assessment.

practice_exams.instruction_en: Describe your morning routine in two sentences, using a frequency adverb.
practice_exams.prompt: Describe your morning routine in two sentences, using a frequency adverb.
practice_exams.answer_example: I usually wake up early. I often eat breakfast with my family.
practice_exams.rubric: Assess task response, sentence structure, tense, vocabulary, spelling. Accept equivalent correct answers; needs evaluation.

小学二年级 / Primary Year 2.title: Past events / 过去的事件
